title: Mexican Lamb Koftas
description: A flavorful and spicy lamb kofta recipe inspired by Mexican cuisine. Serve with your favorite toppings and sides.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, combine the lamb, Mexican stir fry sauce, cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Do not overmix the lamb mixture.
Shape the lamb mixture into 8-10 koftas.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the koftas for 5-7 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 63°C (145°F) for medium-rare.
Transfer the koftas to a plate and let them rest for 5 minutes.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve with your favorite toppings and sides.
